description: Warn when a written Markdown document is missing required sections. Finds python3, python or py (Windows) and does nothing if none is installed.

hooks.command: for p in python3 python py; do if "$p" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 8))' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/check_required_sections.py"; fi; done; exit 0
